title: Sony plans for its games to be digital-only from 2028 amid controversy over the end of discs
summary: Former developers reveal the company's strict guidelines amid criticism over the elimination of physical format, while a great offer encourages players to stock up on disc titles before the definitive digital transition.

title: Capcom plans to release a Resident Evil game every year and bets on remakes to achieve this
summary: The Japanese company's strategy aims to sustain the pace of annual releases with remake titles, which in turn allows financing and enabling the development of other IPs like Pragmata.

title: Dan Houser, co-founder of Rockstar, defends the permanence of physical format in video games
summary: The creator of Grand Theft Auto states that although personally he doesn't care if games come out on disc, he believes that companies should continue offering physical support to players.

title: Final Fantasy XIV announces major changes to the housing system and reveals details of the Evercold expansion
summary: Square Enix presents the improvements requested by the community for the housing system alongside a new job, a crossover raid, and the extended trailer of the expansion.

title: Marvel confirms at San Diego Comic-Con 2026 its upcoming Black Panther and Ghost Rider movies
summary: The biggest rumors about future MCU projects come true at the publisher's annual event, driving fans wild with revelations of new films and series.
